# Generic email assets
These seven HTML/plain-text pairs are public-safe reusable shells only. They contain no subscriber information, actual campaign copy, private operations manual, verified address, or unpublished product claims. `.html.txt` is intentionally source text, not an HTML site page. The repository is public; this directory is not a privacy boundary. Populated 31-campaign working package is maintained separately. Copy the HTML source to the approved provider HTML editor, replace all `[[...]]` placeholders via authorized private provider configuration, and test the provider-rendered unsubscribe link. Do not send shells or use marketing templates for essential transactional notices. No email automation is activated here.
